lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: The Queen has her jelly. The fog in the hive is lifting.

lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: She remembers the Bell. She named the next stretch: the Crossroads.

lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: And this is Heal. Use it when a {C282} falls.

lines.speaker: yezi
lines.en: The east road is open. Walk it while the Queen still remembers you.
